name: Dayton
takeaway: Dayton aggregation moved from 8.71¢ to 10.691¢ (100% renewable) in June 2026 and continues to the June 2027 meter read — a 22.7% step-up, the largest in the AES Ohio footprint.
hook: Dayton residents are in the city aggregation at 10.691 cents, up from 8.71 in June. Is your account on that program or on its own contract?
notes: City of Dayton aggregation (SOPEC / AEP Energy): 10.691¢/kWh Jun 2026 to Jun 2027 per Energy Choice Matters, 2026-04-09. Prior term 8.71¢. AES Ohio (formerly Dayton Power & Light) territory.
